newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Goodyear, other consumers seek rubber in Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Goodyear, other consumers seek rubber in Singapore.

text.p: Goodyear Tire and other major consumers were said to be looking for several hundred tonnes of rubber on Friday, but business in the Singapore rubber market was thin due to the absence of many players, dealers said.
Traders said most of the players in the market have left town for the annual industry dinner in the Thai rubber centre of Hat Yai later on Friday.

"I heard Goodyear is looking to buy some SIR20 and that other buyers were looking for a few hundred tonnes of RSS3 grade rubber among others," a rubber trader said. "But the market is in a holiday mood and volume looks thin."
